title: Kagamine Len — To Give Them Strength〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, Len, you seek while we hide!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Grr...!
But I really wanted to hide!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's too bad.
But this maze of alleyways should make it fun for us hiders.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Still, I wish MEIKO decided to join us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, she has her hands full testing out those new menu items. Anyway, let's get started. Count to a hundred for us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone, hide♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna find you guys in no time...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Where should I begin looking...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try starting with the one that Kohane said reminded her of Mexico!
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Aha!
Found you, Rin, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line: What?! Already?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You really thought I wouldn't find you two? Those drums seemed like a pretty obvious hiding place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Argh! That's why I said we should split up!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I didn't know where else to go!
I ran out of time to find a different hiding spot!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Would any of them actually go this far down to hide...? Huh? That sign...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh! Found you, Miku!
Why'd you choose such a small sign to hide behind?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I thought I could contort myself just right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I guess this is it. That's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, that just leaves KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seriously, where is he?! Why can't we find him?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you think he's hiding in one of the alleys we haven't explored yet?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... But we've been walking around for a while now. I feel like we've seen just about...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len...
In this situation, you need to think more like KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He started in the plaza just like the rest of us, and he only had a hundred seconds to hide. What would he do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What would he do...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just try putting yourself in his shoes for a second. For example...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Try thinking about what he's like when he's teaching you how to be a good DJ.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When he's teaching me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, he usually just...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, KAITO?
What should I do whenever I'm having trouble coming up with any good ideas?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I know...!
Why don't you try thinking about what worked for you in the past?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In the past?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! In other words, you can use the past to see things from a different perspective!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I mean, let's be honest...
Good ideas don't grow on trees or anything.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, if you're struggling to come up with one, I don't think you should be afraid of looking back on the past!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll give that a try...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, that means...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think I know where KAITO's hiding!
This way!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! W-Wait for us!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, you found me.
I'm amazed that you were able to figure out my plan to hide in plain sight.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now I see...
You decided to hide in a crate right by where Len was counting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I never would've thought to hide right under his nose. What a great idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wasn't it?!
I thought it was brilliant if I do say so myself!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, Len, you win this time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heehee. That was a piece of cake!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Alright, to be fair, I probably wouldn't have found him if Miku hadn't said anything...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But he doesn't need to know that!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let's play again!
I'm definitely gonna hide this time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rock, paper...
